legal.draft: Draft. This text has not been reviewed by a lawyer yet and may change before launch.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.privacy.what.heading: What we keep
legal.privacy.what.body: Your email address and sign-in details (held by our sign-in provider), the theme you chose, your timezone and reminder time, your habits and check-ins, your journal entries and moods, and your achievements. We also keep a record of your one-time purchase.
legal.privacy.journal.heading: Your journal is yours
legal.privacy.journal.body: Journal text is stored only so you can read, search and export it. Our team can't read it through any admin tool, it never appears in logs or analytics, and it is never used on share cards or for advertising. We don't sell your data.
legal.privacy.who.heading: Who handles it
legal.privacy.who.body: We use Cloudflare to run the app, Supabase (hosted in the United States) to store data, Clerk for sign-in, Stripe for payments and Resend to send reminder emails. Each only receives what it needs to do its job.
legal.privacy.transfer.heading: Transfers outside your country
legal.privacy.transfer.body: Your data is stored in the United States. If you are in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, that is a transfer of your data outside your region, which relies on our storage provider's data processing agreement and the Standard Contractual Clauses (or the EU-US Data Privacy Framework).
legal.privacy.rights.heading: Your choices
legal.privacy.rights.body: You can download everything you have stored, or delete your account and all its data, at any time from Settings. Deletion is immediate in the live service, and copies in backups are removed as those backups rotate out, within 30 days. Reminder emails have a one-click unsubscribe.
legal.privacy.cookies.heading: Cookies
legal.privacy.cookies.body: We use only the cookies needed to keep you signed in. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.
legal.terms.title: Terms of use
legal.terms.what.heading: What you're buying
legal.terms.what.body: littleHYPE is a one-time purchase that gives one person lifetime access to the app and all of its included themes. It is not a subscription. You can switch between the included themes at any time.
legal.terms.refund.heading: Refunds
legal.terms.refund.body: You can ask for a refund within 14 days of purchase. A refund removes your access and permanently deletes all of your data, and you will be warned before it is processed.
legal.terms.use.heading: Using the app
legal.terms.use.body: The app is for your own personal use. Please keep your sign-in private, and don't try to break or misuse the service.
legal.terms.content.heading: Your content
legal.terms.content.body: What you write is yours. We only store and show it to you. Sharing a card is always your choice, and cards never contain journal text.
legal.terms.changes.heading: Changes
legal.terms.changes.body: We may update these terms or the app. If we make a change that matters, we will tell you before it applies.

landing.why.heading: Why write anything down at all?
landing.why.1.title: Your head gets quieter.
landing.why.1.body: A worry on a page is smaller than a worry in your skull. Three honest lines at the end of the day is enough to put it down.
landing.why.2.title: You start to notice the pattern.
landing.why.2.body: Bad sleep, bad Tuesday. Good run, good week. You can't see it in the moment; you can see it on the page a month later.
landing.why.3.title: Habits stick when something is watching.
landing.why.3.body: Not an alarm. A ship's log that expects a report, a notebook that wants the next page, a seal that holds for seven days.
landing.vs.heading: The boring apps vs. littleHYPE
landing.vs.intro: You know the ones. Beige. Sensible. Built by people who think a flame icon is a personality.
landing.vs.1.them: A text box and a Save button.
landing.vs.1.us: A captain's log. A scroll. A page in a notebook you'd actually buy.
landing.vs.2.us: Twelve days in orbit. An enchantment holding. Day twelve, still breathing.
landing.vs.4.them: Miss a day, lose everything, feel like a failure.
landing.vs.4.us: Miss a day, get a joke, start again. Your badges are yours for good.
landing.vs.5.us: One payment. Yours for life. Four worlds, switch whenever you like.
landing.vs.6.them: Your private thoughts, feeding someone's AI.
landing.vs.6.us: Your writing stays yours. No ads, no AI training, and nobody at littleHYPE can read it.
landing.how.heading: Write. Tick. Earn.
landing.how.1.title: Write
landing.how.1.body: A fresh prompt every day, in your world's voice, or a blank page. Bold, lists, a mood. It saves as you type.
landing.how.2.title: Tick
landing.how.2.body: Your habits, one tap each, with a little moment every time: a ping, a scribble, a spark, a stamp. Rest days don't break anything.
landing.how.3.title: Earn
landing.how.3.body: Badges for showing up, never for writing more. Titles you can share without sharing a word of what you wrote.
landing.pricing.heading: One price. No premium tier.
landing.pricing.body: Everything is included: all four worlds, every badge, every future update to them.
landing.faq.heading: Questions people actually ask
landing.faq.1.a: Yes. Your entries are yours alone. They never appear in emails, share cards, analytics or our admin tools, and they are never used to train anything. You can download everything, or delete your account and all of it, from Settings.
landing.faq.2.a: Any time, from Settings. Your entries, habits and badges come with you, and you can switch back.
landing.faq.3.a: No. littleHYPE is a one-time purchase. A monthly option is coming for people who prefer it, but lifetime is the better deal and always will be.
landing.faq.4.a: Both. It's a website that works on any phone, tablet or computer, so there's nothing to install and nothing to sync.
landing.faq.5.q: What happens if I stop for a week?
landing.faq.5.a: You get a card with a joke about it and a button to start again. Streaks reset; badges and titles you've earned never do.
